title: Implement UI Feed projection isolation and authorized human feed reads
verify: UI Feed events always set visible_to_agents=false and consumable_by_agents=false.
Authorized humans can read display projections without granting agents UI Feed access.
evidence_required: UIFeedEvent contract tests for projection flags, source refs, redaction, and authorized reads.
UI/e2e smoke proving human-facing feed uses display payload only.
constraints: UI Feed stores display payloads, source refs, task/approval refs, and safe presentation metadata only.
UI markdown cannot change claim type, safety status, Plant state, governance authority, or dataset trainability.
invariants: UI Feed is human presentation only and never agent working context.
Future agent runs must retrieve underlying approved domain refs through context builder, not UI Feed replay.
verification_targets: Authorized human feed read with no agent-consumable flag leakage.
